Founder: Tell me about the last time a client paid late.
Rui: Honestly it does not really happen here. A friend of mine runs an agency and she complains about it.
Founder: How do you handle invoices?
Rui: Our accountant sends them. I have never looked at it much.
Founder: Is it something you would want to fix?
Rui: Maybe one day. It seems like a problem for bigger companies.
